latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly equipping the physical weapon on the proven warrior raised visible equipped power by 28.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the next main encounter with both damage leaders armed and compare their contributions and clear result.

latestAttribution.cause: The full warrior again ranked first and supplied 53.94% of team damage, confirming it as the stable direct-damage lead in the new encounter.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Test the newly unlocked full mage in place of the lowest observed damage contributor while retaining the proven warrior damage lead.

latestAttribution.cause: The newly fielded full mage immediately ranked first with 41.43% of team damage, confirming the swap as a successful direct-output upgrade over the former rank-four militia.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Compare the newly unlocked berserker with the lowest-damage active member in a later combat while preserving the proven mage and warrior.

latestAttribution.cause: The berserker supplied 27.47% of team damage at rank two, decisively exceeding the removed healer's 3.39% share and confirming the damage-focused swap.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Continue with the four-damage roster into the next main encounter and watch whether the absence of dedicated healing causes an ally death or loss.
